facts.rationale: Corrects the unsupported once-only transition while preserving the observed initialization order and persistent register-access role.
facts.value: The source-level register-pointer globals have zero-initialized static storage. Every invocation of GXInit unconditionally assigns __piReg, __cpReg, __peReg, and __memReg their uncached hardware mappings before FIFO, pixel-engine, and write-gather setup. There is no once-only guard or subsequent clearing assignment in this translation unit; later initialization writes through __cpReg. This describes the globals' behavior without establishing their compiled section layout.

facts.rationale: Preserves the supported bootstrap explanation while removing an unsupported one-time execution guarantee.
facts.value: Initializes the GX graphics interface by establishing the CPU/GP command FIFO from caller-provided memory, mapping hardware interfaces, seeding software register shadows and baseline GPU commands, constructing default texture/TLUT regions, and applying the high-level defaults through __GXInitGX. Returns the library-owned initialized FifoObj. This is a subsystem bootstrap routine, but the implementation has no guard restricting it to one invocation.

evidence.why: Complete bounded lookup and NULL branch.
Assertion followed by unconditional commands and region dereferences.

facts.rationale: Distinguishes assertion-based validation from guaranteed runtime rejection of invalid callback results.
facts.value: Performs a read-only bounded lookup: unsigned indices below 20 return a pointer into gx->TlutRegions, while indices 20 and above return NULL. It does not mutate state, issue hardware writes, or select a fallback. __GXInitGX installs it as the default policy. GXLoadTlut validates its result with an assertion, not an ordinary error-return branch; if assertions are absent, an invalid selection proceeds toward hardware commands and a null-region dereference.
